      Quick test recipes
      
      
      
        Verify the firmware over WiFi from any terminal:
      
      
      
      curl http://<esp-ip>/health
curl http://<esp-ip>/stats
curl http://<esp-ip>/csi/latest
      
      
      
        Or hit them through the backend (no need to know the IP):
      
      
      
      curl /api/firmware-status
curl /api/diagnostics
      
    
      
  
      

  
  
      
    
      
      
      Privacy by architecture
      
      
      
        Echolocate is built so that surveillance is physically impossible,
        not merely against policy. The schema below has nowhere to put an image,
        and the camera shutter is closed by default.
      
      
    
      

    
      
      
      
        
      What IS collected
      
        
        
          
      • Aggregate occupancy levels (empty / low / moderate / high)
        • 
          
      • Anonymous rotating tokens (changed every 15 min)
        • 
          
      • Zone + time pairs you visited (only if you opted in)
        • 
          
      • Spatial metadata extracted from threshold-triggered snapshots — counts and clusters near features
        • 
        
      
      
      
      
      
        
      What is NEVER collected
      
        
        
          
      • Photos, video, or audio
        • 
          
      • Faces or biometric features
        • 
          
      • Names, email, phone, account info
        • 
          
      • Browsing or location history outside this space
        • 
          
      • Identity information of any kind
        • 
        
      
      
      
    
      

    
      
      
      Image lifecycle
      
      
         capture → ~2s in RAM → Claude Vision → discard
      ↓                         ↓                  ↓
  [no disk]              [structured JSON]   [memory cleared]
                                ↓
                       saved to SQLite store
                       (no image columns exist)
